title: The espresso machine, ii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Gully reads the manual. The first shot. The machine screams. The dog leaves the shack and doesn't come back until Thursday.

panels.composition: The shack. The two-group machine on the bait counter, enormous, chrome, wrong. GULLY with a manual in Italian. WOOD on the crate. BARNABY under the counter.

balloons.text: I bought it in Coos Bay.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, xerox grain, a huge chrome two-group espresso machine on a bait-shop counter, a young man in an apron squinting at a manual, another on a crate, a dog beneath

panels.composition: Gully's hand on a lever. Everything on the counter leaning away.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, close-up of a hand pulling a chrome lever on an espresso machine, no words

panels.composition: The machine SCREAMS. Steam. The bait tanks rattle. The dog is a streak out the door. Wood's crate goes over.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, a bait shack full of steam as an espresso machine screams, a dog streaking out the door, a young man tipping over backwards off a crate, bait tanks rattling

panels.composition: After. Gully holding a tiny cup. A quarter inch of black sludge in it. Wood upright again. No dog.

balloons.text: The book says it's a shot.

image.prompt: brush-pen black-and-white, a young man in an apron proudly holding a tiny espresso cup of black sludge, another looking at it, an empty doorway

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: 'I bought it in Coos Bay.' The dog leaves until Thursday.
